build_D2GoRunner_model: build a detection model from config using Detectron2GoRunner build_model method
run_D2GoRunner_train: run training with Detectron2GoRunner do_train method on a detection model
run_D2GoRunner_test: run evaluation with Detectron2GoRunner do_test method on a trained detection model
scale_default_d2_configs: scale detection config learning rate and iterations based on GPU world size
create_Detectron2GoRunner: create a Detectron2GoRunner instance to manage training and evaluation of detection models
